verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's first-party software for the RTX 5080 includes Project G-Assist, an AI assistant that helps users tune and optimize their system. The local AI offering also lets users "add your files for smarter, more personalized results," which gives a thin basis for AI insights drawn from the user's own data. Both are one-line marketing claims, and it is ambiguous whether they belong to the GPU product or to separate companion software. missing for 10: concrete documentation of what insights or suggestions are generated from user data, how G-Assist surfaces recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration, clarity that this ships as part of the product.
